statement: On seed 119, free-ω LM-minimization of photometry over a forward A→C window (window-as-objective) escapes the hard-shoot trap and recovers Band A (ρ 0.0300, ω-err 0.57°), where hard-connecting the endpoints gives Band D. SCOPE: N=1, and the seed run was oracle-seeded — discrimination against far/phantom pairs is untested.
